evidence: package-lock.json:25808 (node_modules/follow-redirects 1.16.1 at e15e6f84e, dev; affected >=1.16.0 <=1.16.1, patched 1.16.2, published 2026-10-25)

payload.rule_violated: npm-audit gate (scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs): an advisory with a patched release is fixed, not excepted
payload.notes: External drift. Dev only: root-production never reported it, and every runtime image installs with --omit=dev. npm's no-fix verdict reads nx's exact pin and not the root override, which already lifts the one copy (SUPPLY-HIGH-024). 1.16.2 differs from 1.16.1 in index.js (one line), README.md and the version. Fix: the override moves to ^1.16.2, the lock to 1.16.2 (npm changes only this entry; its integrity matches the registry tarball), and a dependency-security floor of 1.16.2 declared in overrides. With it nx reaches only GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (moderate), below the root-full floor.
